o1: Predicted to enable several functions, including G-protein beta/gamma-subunit complex binding activity; GTPase activity; and guanyl ribonucleotide binding activity. Involved in embryonic axis specification; establishment of spindle orientation; asymmetric cell division; mitotic spindle positioning; and cytokinesis. Located in cell cortex. Is expressed in several structures, including AB; C; D; neurons; and pharynx. Is part of the G-protein signaling pathway; the heterotrimeric G-protein signaling pathway. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in achromatopsia 4; color blindness; congenital stationary night blindness 1G; congenital stationary night blindness autosomal dominant 3; and night blindness. Orthologous to several human genes including GNAI1 (G protein subunit alpha i1).
